tasks.title: Add a new API endpoint
tasks.description: Create a new endpoint at /api/goodbye that uses the createFarewell function
aiHints: Open src/index.ts
Add a new GET endpoint for /api/goodbye
Import and use the createFarewell function from src/api/hello.ts
Return a JSON response similar to the /api/hello endpoint

tasks.title: Implement name validation
tasks.description: Complete the isValidName function with proper validation rules
aiHints: Open src/api/hello.ts
Find the isValidName function
Add checks for: empty strings, valid characters, reasonable length
Consider using regular expressions for character validation

tasks.title: Add error handling
tasks.description: Implement proper error handling for all API endpoints
aiHints: Add try-catch blocks to endpoints in src/index.ts
Create a custom error handler middleware
Return appropriate HTTP status codes for different error types
Log errors with timestamps

tasks.title: Implement multi-language greetings
tasks.description: Complete the createAdvancedGreeting function with support for multiple languages
aiHints: Open src/api/hello.ts
Find the createAdvancedGreeting function
Add greeting translations for 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de'
Implement formal/informal tone variations
Add emoji support based on includeEmoji option

tasks.title: Add TypeScript types for responses
tasks.description: Create proper TypeScript interfaces for all API responses
aiHints: Create a new file src/types.ts
Define interfaces for: ApiInfo, GreetingResponse, HealthCheck
Use these interfaces in endpoint response types
Ensure all responses are properly typed

tasks.title: Write unit tests
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the greeting functions
aiHints: Install Jest and ts-jest
Create tests/api/hello.test.ts
Test createGreeting, createFarewell, isValidName
Test edge cases: empty strings, special characters, very long names
Aim for >80% code coverage

tasks.title: Add request logging middleware
tasks.description: Implement middleware to log all incoming requests
aiHints: Create src/middleware/logger.ts
Log request method, path, timestamp, and response time
Add the middleware to the Express app
Consider using a logging library like Winston or Pino

tasks.title: Implement rate limiting
tasks.description: Add rate limiting to prevent API abuse
aiHints: Install express-rate-limit package
Create rate limiting configuration
Apply to all API endpoints
Add custom error messages for rate limit exceeded
Consider different limits for different endpoints
